backdrop.source: Selection brightness calibrated against the user's native 1080x1920 screenshots; the background's persistent blur is configured by background_blur.

choices.portrait_source: Original int_down icons visible in the user's reference screenshots. Presentation only; no reward values are inferred or exported.
